title: Aggregate spending by category and render a table
task: Implement `Aggregate(r io.Reader) (Totals, error)` in package `spend`: input is CSV rows `date,category,cents`, output is the total cents per category plus the grand total and the row count. A malformed row is an error naming its line number. Then `Totals.Table() string` renders categories sorted by name with right-aligned amounts and a final `TOTAL` row.
